premise.claim: IsMounted and GetMountedAlluxioPaths read fields[2] of every line of the `alluxio fs mount` output without checking how many fields the line has. An empty output, or a line with fewer than three fields such as a blank line, makes them panic with `index out of range [2]`.

findings.evidence: Contract test panics on merge base (base.go:323 / base.go:356, index out of range [2]) and passes on PR head 2a7f2322; full pkg/ddc/alluxio/... suite ok on head (results/head-full-alluxio-pkg.txt)
